skills.description: Specialized skill for generating CCER Project Design Documents (PDD) for grid-connected offshore wind power projects under methodology CCER-01-002-V01. Provides step-by-step guidance through the full PDD lifecycle: methodology applicability assessment, emission reduction calculation, monitoring plan design, and validation readiness review. Built upon a real approved case study (中广核惠州港口二期PA450, 450MW) with actual validation findings from China Classification Society (CCSC). Use this skill when the user mentions offshore wind, 海上风电, 海上风力发电, or needs to write a PDD for an offshore wind CCER project.
